scenes.notes: LOOK: dark navy #0A0F1F, brand blue #4C9BFF, gold #F5B83D, Heebo. Concept: same task, two employees, split screen with timers; the divider line is THE GAP that opens into a chasm, multiplies across teams, then closes. Narration: ElevenLabs v4 (Callum) premixed with original ElevenLabs music in assets/gap/soundtrack.mp3. ~30s. Race: right employee with AI finishes at 00:40, left still scrolling a 40-page PDF.
The divider opens into a glowing gap. 'לא כישרון.' then gold 'זה ידע.'; a dimension line labelled 'פער ידע'.
Grid of team tiles, some with red gaps. 'בכמה צוותים?'
Gaps close one by one in gold. 'המחלקה העסקית', 'היחידה ללימודי חוץ', 'סוגרים פערי ידע', pills AI / סייבר, 'בהתאמה לארגון שלכם.'
